parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- zh\_cn: Chinese. This is the default value.

- en\_us: English.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description:
The ID of the industry-specific template.

> Call [DescribeCategoryTemplateList](~~2399296~~) to get the ID of the industry-specific template.
